verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a first-party API reference for Tax Calculations at docs.stripe.com/api, plus a sandbox where tax behavior can be previewed, so a reference and a place to try calls both exist. Nothing shows the reference itself is interactive or has runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec paths that would enable interactive explorers all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of interactive or runnable examples in the API reference, an in-browser try-it console, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
